About Barpeta Bongaigaon College,Langla
With an objective to impart higher education to the students of greater Langla area in General and to those for whom higher education was always beyond their in particular Langla.
The BB College, Langla affiliated to Gauhati University is at present imparting education in the Arts stream. All the faculty members of the college is qualified and experienced who always try to disseminate knowledge with updating information to the students and play a vital role of facilitator, friend, Philosopher and guide for the result of the student always satisfactory.

From the desk of the Principal i/c.......
BarpetaBongaigaon College, Langla, since its inception in the year 1992 has crossed 32 years of academic journey. We have come a long way, and our stakeholders have struggled tirelessly with an inexhaustible fund of patience and perseverance to transform BarpetaBongaigaon College, Langla to an institution of academic excellence. The mission of the college is to nurture the budding talents of the youngsters and get them ready to face the challenges that are thrown in their way of life, thereby transitioning them from being consumers of knowledge. As Principal i/c, I benignly welcome all stakeholders of BarpetaBongaigaon College, Langla to come forward to work together with firm commitment and determination in this transitional period to make the college a pioneering institution of Higher Education.
Mohd.Anwaru-Al Islam Khan
Principal i/c.
BarpetaBongaigaon College, Langla.
